intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Four, Kaladin's bridge crew in Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains.
A quiet member of Bridge Four who became the go-between for Navani and Kaladin during the occupation of Urithiru.

items.text: Dabbid was born with the umbilical cord around his neck, leaving him with a disorder. He didn't speak until he was six, and his condition worsened after his mother died.

He came to the war on the Shattered Plains washing a lighteyes' clothes. When the man's wife falsely accused him of fathering her child to protect her lover, Dabbid was made a bridgeman in Sadeas's warcamp as punishment.

In 1173 Dabbid joined Bridge Four. On one run a horse from his own side trampled him, breaking his arm, and Kaladin and Rock dragged him to safety. Kaladin splinted the arm with Parshendi arrows and Dabbid's shirt.

Dabbid stayed in shock long afterwards and didn't speak. Sadeas wouldn't feed wounded bridgemen, so the crew fed him from secret sales of knobweed sap. Once healed, he helped Lopen carry water and supplies on runs; Lopen called him 'moolie'.
While Kaladin secretly trained the others in the chasms, Dabbid scavenged with Rock, Lopen and Shen to meet the crew's quota. He and Lopen also smuggled money and Parshendi armour out of the chasms.
On his last bridge run, Sadeas abandoned Dalinar's army. Bridge Four went back to help, and Dabbid ran with the crew to rescue Dalinar, who bought their freedom with his Shardblade.
In Dalinar's army Kaladin set Dabbid and Shen to help Lopen and Rock feed the bridgemen, and Dabbid became one of Rock's most capable kitchen helpers.

Dabbid stayed in the warcamp during the Battle of Narak, then moved with Bridge Four to Urithiru. Still silent, he became the crew's unofficial mascot. When Bridge Four rushed to a burning caravan, he and Lopen handed out the spears and shields.
Like Rlain, Dabbid could not draw in Stormlight, and Rlain sensed the others thought it was probably best that way.
The Sibling reached out to Dabbid and asked him to swap a spanreed gem to contact Navani. He was caught, but when the singers invaded he showed Navani how to speak to the Sibling directly.

Guided by the Sibling, Dabbid carried broth, fabrials and gemstones from Navani to Kaladin's hiding place. As Kaladin went to fight, Dabbid spoke his first words since that last bridge run: "Life before death." He and Rlain then helped wake Kaladin.
As Kaladin prepared to leave for Shinovar, he saw an honorspren named Lusintia trailing Dabbid. Kaladin told Skar that whatever happened with Dabbid's condition, Dabbid would have a say.

appearance.text: A wiry, youthful-looking Alethi man, younger than Kaladin, with skin on the paler side.

personality.text: He pretended to be mute so Bridge Four wouldn't notice his disorder, and remains traumatised by the bridge runs.
